interpretation_scope: Real Qwen3.5-0.8B execution on Apple MPS with eager attention. The POC tests whether preserving already-valid full-attention KV while rebuilding lagging linear/recurrent state provides incremental compute savings over ordinary suffix replay. It is not a CUDA/vLLM benchmark.

heuristic_gates.promising: correct + frozen KV unchanged + median K/V-projection-bypass speedup >=10% vs normal suffix replay
heuristic_gates.activation_pivot: K/V-only <10% but oracle full-block skip >=25%; requires activation/state design rather than KV-only recovery
heuristic_gates.weak: both K/V-only and oracle headroom small

critical_caveat: The oracle path caches exact post-decoder-block hidden activations and is intentionally not a deployable baseline. It is an upper-bound probe for how much full-block compute could be removed if extra activation state were retained.
